name: Cute Warrior Girl (큐트 여전사)
detailed_description:
This game is an adventure story about a young female warrior set in a medieval world.

This is a simple yet enjoyable action-adventure game where a cute female warrior defeats the orcs that are harming the villagers.

Talk to NPCs in the royal palace and the forest to gather hints and track down the hidden orc hideout.
Your combat abilities change based on the experience you earn, leading to multiple endings where you may defeat the orc or suffer defeat.

With simple controls (arrow keys + spacebar), anyone can easily play, and the average playtime is around 10–15 minutes.

It’s a charming mini-game featuring adorable characters, a short but immersive story, and lighthearted humor.

One day, orcs began appearing in rural villages throughout the kingdom, committing acts of looting and violence.

They were so quick and targeted only the weakest villages,
making it nearly impossible for the royal army to defend or keep up with them.

Mercenary knights were hired and sent into the orcs’ lair,
but none of them ever returned.

To prevent further destruction, the king made a bold declaration:
any mercenary who could defeat the orcs would be granted any wish they desired.

Upon hearing this, the confident warrior Fiora visited the king
and boldly declared that she would take down the orcs herself.

Although this game appears to follow a JRPG style, it is actually closer to a simple adventure game.

It can be completed in a short amount of time,
and even those unfamiliar with JRPGs will find it easy to play.

Controls:
Move: Arrow Keys
Talk/Interact: Spacebar
